title: Rescript
claim: Product Hunt: Rescript — A free, open source, Descript alternative. Runs in-browser.
why_good: A free, in-browser open-source Descript alternative — edit audio/video by editing text, a proven-loved workflow now open and free.
value: Freemium: free in-browser editing, paid exports/collab/cloud; Descript proves people pay for text-based editing.
risk: Descript is well-funded and polished; browser performance + transcription quality are the bar, and it's crowded.
evidence: Productivity, Open Source, GitHub, Photo & Video
method: producthunt api v2 (top launches, last 2d) + startup-worthiness score

zh.claim: Product Hunt: Rescript —— 免费开源的 Descript 替代,浏览器内运行。
zh.why_good: 一个免费、浏览器内的开源 Descript 替代——像编辑文字一样编辑音视频,一个被验证深受喜爱的工作流,现在开源免费。
zh.value: 免费增值:浏览器编辑免费,导出/协作/云收费;Descript 证明有人为 文字式编辑 付费。
zh.risk: Descript 有钱且精致;浏览器性能 + 转写质量是门槛,而且赛道拥挤。
